# Wild and The Sun Açaí Cafe

> Family-run açaí café inside Aberfoyle Hub Shopping Centre, Aberfoyle Park, South Australia, in Adelaide’s southern suburbs. Açaí bowls, smoothies, specialty coffee, pastries and café food. Dine in, order ahead for pickup, get delivery, or book a table.

## Key facts

- Name: Wild and The Sun Açaí Cafe (also written Wild and the Sun Acai Cafe, Wild & The Sun)
- Address: Shop 4, Aberfoyle Hub, 130-150 Hub Drive, Aberfoyle Park SA 5159, Australia. Inside Aberfoyle Hub Shopping Centre (corner Hub Drive and Sandpiper Crescent), near Woolworths.
- Nearby suburbs: Happy Valley, Flagstaff Hill, Coromandel Valley, Chandlers Hill. City of Onkaparinga, about 20 km south of Adelaide CBD.
- Phone: 0451 661 351
- Opening hours: Tuesday to Saturday 9am–5pm and Sunday 9am–2pm, closed Monday. Public holiday hours can vary.
- Known for: açaí bowls (Classic Açaí Bowl with banana, strawberry, granola and honey; Kids Açaí Bowl), pistachio latte, Dubai chocolate croissant, loaded banana bread, waffles.
- Type: café, açaí bar and coffee shop. Family run. Dine in and takeaway.
- Book a table: call 0451 661 351 (see https://wild-and-the-sun.pages.dev/book/)
- Order ahead for pickup: https://wild-and-the-sun.square.site/s/order#most-popular
- Delivery: Uber Eats, https://www.ubereats.com/au/store/wild-and-the-sun-acai-cafe-aberfoyle-park/57cwlGKJVz2NsWWez7BPSQ
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/wild_and_the_sun_acai_cafe/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Wild-and-the-Sun-Acai-Cafe-61572911067431/

## Menu highlights

Current items and prices are on the online ordering store. Highlights:

### Açaí

Açaí is a deep-purple berry from the Amazon. We serve it soft and creamy, topped with fresh fruit, granola, nut butters and drizzles.

- Classic Açaí Bowl: Açaí with banana, strawberry, granola and honey.
- Small Açaí: A smaller serve of our creamy açaí.
- Kids Açaí Bowl: Banana, granola, strawberry and agave.
- Açaí add-on: Add açaí to a smoothie or chia pudding.

### Coffee, lattes and tea

Espresso coffee made to order, plus our specialty lattes, hot and iced.

- Espresso coffee: Flat white, latte, cappuccino, long black, macchiato and espresso.
- Pistachio Latte: A creamy pistachio latte, one of our most popular drinks.
- Cookie Butter Latte: A latte made with cookie butter.
- Spiced Matcha Latte: A matcha latte with spice.
- Iced Strawberry Latte: Iced latte with strawberry.
- Pistachio Affogato: Pistachio and espresso, affogato style.
- Iced coffee, mocha, chai, turmeric latte and hot chocolate: Café favourites, plus a babyccino for little ones.
- Tea: English breakfast, green tea and iced peach tea cold brew.

### Pastries and sweets

Croissants, cakes and treats from the counter.

- Dubai Chocolate Croissant: A croissant with Dubai chocolate.
- Pistachio Croissant: A croissant with pistachio.
- Dubai Chocolate: Mini Dubai chocolates or a whole Dubai choc block.
- Loaded Banana Bread: Fresh banana, peanut butter, chia and hemp seeds, and Nutella choc chips.
- Waffles: Served with ice cream, strawberries and powdered sugar.
- Cheesecake and Pistachio Cheesecake: By the slice.
- Gluten-Free Brownie: Served with Nutella cream and fresh strawberries.
- Banana bread, orange loaf, brownies and cookies: Choc chip and oatmeal cookies for a quick treat.

### Savoury

Something warm and filling for lunch.

- Quesadilla: Veggie, chicken or beef.
- Spinach, Ham and Cheese Croissant: A croissant with spinach, ham and cheese.
- Gourmet Ham and Cheese Roll: A ham and cheese roll.

### Smoothies and cold drinks

Smoothies, milkshakes and grab-and-go drinks.

- Smoothies: Berry, mango and green smoothies, with protein or açaí to add.
- Milkshakes: Classic milkshakes.
- Fridge drinks: Grab-and-go cold drinks.

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Wild and The Sun?

Wild and The Sun is at Shop 4, Aberfoyle Hub, 130-150 Hub Drive, Aberfoyle Park SA 5159, inside Aberfoyle Hub Shopping Centre near Woolworths. It’s in Aberfoyle Park in Adelaide’s southern suburbs, close to Happy Valley, Flagstaff Hill, Coromandel Valley and Chandlers Hill.

### What is an açaí bowl?

Açaí (say ah-sah-EE) is a deep-purple berry from the Amazon with a rich berry and chocolate flavour. We serve it soft and creamy, topped with fresh fruit, granola, nut butters and drizzles. Our Classic Açaí Bowl comes with banana, strawberry, granola and honey, and there’s a Kids Açaí Bowl too.

### Is Wild and The Sun only an açaí bar?

No, it’s a full café. As well as açaí bowls and smoothies, there’s espresso coffee and specialty lattes such as pistachio, cookie butter and spiced matcha, Dubai chocolate and pistachio croissants, loaded banana bread, waffles, quesadillas and milkshakes.

### What are the opening hours?

We’re open Tuesday to Saturday 9am–5pm and Sunday 9am–2pm, closed Monday. Hours can change on public holidays, so call 0451 661 351 if you’re making a special trip.

### Can I book a table?

Yes. Call 0451 661 351 during opening hours and we’ll save you a table. For birthdays and bigger groups, call us to plan it together.

### Do you do takeaway or delivery?

Yes. Order ahead for pickup through our online store, or order delivery through Uber Eats.

### Are there options for kids and special diets?

There’s a Kids Açaí Bowl and babyccinos for little ones, a veggie quesadilla, and a gluten-free brownie. Please tell the team about any allergies when you order.
